claim_text: CausalCache reallocates exactly B active history-image slots over a complete summary trace; it does not add images or delete event summaries.
comparison: Recent-B versus CausalCache at matched B; unit is one decision prompt.
effect: Protocol identity: both arms contain B active history images.
notes: This is a protocol/property claim, not an empirical performance claim; k is realized, not preset.

claim_text: HGKV creates selective use of relevant restored pixels while staying inside the preregistered recent/wrong drift envelope.
comparison: HGKV s150 versus its own frozen arms on 94 desktop development groups at B=1.
uncertainty: 95% CI for DiD select [+0.0074,+0.0150]; both drifts below epsilon=0.02.
notes: B0 parity is bitwise exact; do not generalize this desktop gate directly to closed-loop task success.

claim_text: CausalCache-P attains the highest zero-shot MobileWorld full-roster mean, but the current overall contrasts are inconclusive.
comparison: CausalCache-P three runs versus summary-only and HGKV+Recent-4 three runs; 117-task strict roster, task-clustered paired mean.
effect: +5.7 percentage points versus summary-only; +3.7 percentage points versus HGKV+Recent-4.
uncertainty: 95% CI [-0.6,+12.0] pp versus summary-only; [-0.9,+8.6] pp versus HGKV+Recent-4.
notes: Both intervals cross zero; do not claim an overall full-roster improvement.

claim_text: The MobileWorld benefit is concentrated on the construction-defined memory-critical split rather than matched controls.
comparison: CausalCache-P versus Recent-4 at B=4; 62 memory-critical tasks and 55 matched single-app controls.
effect: Memory-critical +8.6 pp; controls -1.8 pp; split interaction +10.4 pp.
notes: The split is construction-defined and not selected after seeing per-task outcomes.

claim_text: CausalCache-P is neutral on the matched MobileWorld control split.
comparison: CausalCache-P versus Recent-4 at B=4 on 55 matched single-app controls.
notes: The valid interval crosses zero; say neutral/statistically indistinguishable, not beneficial.

claim_text: Proposal-conditioned two-pass deployment has a higher MobileWorld point estimate than the last-action single-pass efficiency branch.
comparison: CausalCache-LA one-pass versus CausalCache-P after the current repeated-run aggregation.
effect: P is +4.8 percentage points over LA.
notes: The interval crosses zero; LA remains an efficiency branch, while P often incurs a second policy pass.

claim_text: In one audited CartInfoNotificationTask episode, restoring event 7 exposes missing item/order pixels and accompanies a correct successful message, while an independent Recent-4 run types the wrong values and fails.
comparison: Selected r2 versus Recent-4 r2 qualitative episode; B=4 in both runs.
effect: Selected allocation [6,7,8,12], recent tail [11,12,13,14], realized k=3; evaluator 1.0 versus 0.0.
